items.title: validation of the red-team model library against committed pure code
items.purpose: Determination (BFS parity) vs binstd_core.FullVectorElim on synthetic rows mod 1000003; rt_model.am_obs vs am_core; text-level tests/classes vs gate_tests/classify_cell; bands
items.script_text:
"""C03: validate the red-team model library against committed pure code on
synthetic data only. (1) determined_set (BFS parity) vs binstd_core.FullVectorElim
(the I1 class) on random signed relation graphs mod a prime, with synthetic secret
logs; (2) rt_model.am_obs vs binstd_core.am_core; (3) text_tests/text_class vs
gate_tests/classify_cell on the same values. Seed 810095003."""
import json, math, os, random, sys, time
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl")); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
import binstd_core as bc
import rt_model as rm
rng = random.Random(810095003)
P = 1000003
res = {"seed": 810095003, "prime_for_rows": P}
mism_det = 0; trials = 0; t0 = time.time()
for B in (128, 512):
    for rep in range(150):
        edges = [rm.draw_legs(rng, B) for _ in range(B)]
        det, touched = rm.determined_set(B, edges)
        x = [rng.randrange(P) for _ in range(B)]
        el = bc.FullVectorElim(P)
        for (i, s, k, t) in edges:
            co = {i: s}; co[k] = co.get(k, 0) + t
            rhs = sum(v * x[c] for c, v in co.items()) % P
            el.add_row(co, rhs)
        log = el.solve_all()
        ok_vals = all(log[c] == x[c] for c in log)
        if set(log) != {c for c in range(B) if det[c]} or not ok_vals: mism_det += 1
        trials += 1
res["determined_set_vs_FullVectorElim"] = {"trials": trials, "mismatches": mism_det, "B": [128, 512], "reps_each": 150}
# (2)(3) observables and classifiers on simulated arms
mism_obs = mism_cls = 0; n = 0; tim = {}
for (B, mu) in ((128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN), (512, 1.0)):
    t1 = time.time()
    for rep in range(40):
        arm = rm.reuse_arm(rng, B, mu)
        mine = rm.am_obs(arm["rel_att"] * 7, 7, B, mu, arm["per_t"], rm.L_IC)
        recs = [{"L": L, "units": u * 7} for (L, u) in arm["per_t"]]
        theirs = bc.am_core(arm["rel_att"] * 7, 7, B, mu, recs, bc.L_IC)
        if any(abs(mine[k] - theirs[k]) > 1e-9 * max(1, abs(theirs[k])) for k in ("KR", "FR", "d_sigma")):
            mism_obs += 1
        v = rm.values_for_committed(arm, mine)
        zn = None
        if B == 512:
            zarm = rm.reuse_arm(rng, 128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN)
            zob = rm.am_obs(zarm["rel_att"], 1, 128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN, zarm["per_t"], rm.L_IC)
            zn = rm.values_for_committed(zarm, zob)
        if rm.text_tests(v, zn) != bc.gate_tests(v, zn) or rm.text_class(rm.text_tests(v, zn)) != bc.classify_cell(bc.gate_tests(v, zn)):
            mism_cls += 1
        n += 1
    tim[str((B, round(mu, 7)))] = (time.time() - t1) / 40
res["am_obs_vs_am_core"] = {"arms": n, "mismatches": mism_obs}
res["text_vs_committed_tests_and_class"] = {"arms": n, "mismatches": mism_cls}
res["seconds_per_arm"] = tim
res["delta_inf"] = rm.DELTA_INF; res["u_pred"] = rm.U_PRED
res["committed_delta_inf"] = bc.delta_inf(); res["committed_u_pred"] = bc.u_pred()
for (B, mu) in ((128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN), (512, 1.0), (512, 0.5), (512, 2.0)):
    a, b = rm.bands(B, mu, 1365), bc.am_bands(B, mu, 1365)
    res.setdefault("bands_mine_vs_committed", {})[str((B, round(mu, 7)))] = {
        "mine": [a["KR"], a["FR"]], "committed": [list(b["KR"]), list(b["FR"])]}
res["k_pred"] = {"ZN": rm.k_pred(128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN), "bin": rm.k_pred(512, 1.0),
                 "committed_ZN": bc.k_pred(128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN), "committed_bin": bc.k_pred(512, 1.0)}
res["elapsed_s"] = time.time() - t0
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, default=str))

"""C03b: ParityUF (incremental) vs determined_set (BFS) and vs committed FullVectorElim,
on prefixes of random relation sequences. Seed 810095031."""
import json, os, random, sys
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl")); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
import rt_model as rm, binstd_core as bc
rng = random.Random(810095031); mism = 0; checks = 0
for B in (128, 512):
    for rep in range(60):
        uf = rm.ParityUF(B); edges = []
        for r in range(2 * B):
            e = rm.draw_legs(rng, B); edges.append(e); uf.add(*e)

                checks += 1

items.title: H1 abstract-model Monte Carlo (own simulator), nominal and AR-MU edge regimes
items.purpose: J3 (i), (ii), (iv): per-cell false-fail per test and per class, G1 H1 part, null separation, delta sd, T_a z-sd, kappa z under H1; committed vs text classifier replicate by replicate
items.script_text:
"""C04: red-team Monte Carlo of the contract's ABSTRACT MODEL with H1 true
(own simulator rt_model.py written from the specification text). Every draw is
classified twice: by the committed pure functions of binstd_core.py (dry calls:
am_bands, gate_tests, classify_cell, null_check, yield_audit, h1_axis) and by
rt_model's text-level re-implementation; mismatches are counted. No group,
oracle, curve, fixture or declared cell.
usage: c04_h1_mc.py REGIME REPS BASESEED   REGIME in nominal | mu0.5 | mu2.0"""
import json, math, os, random, sys, time
from multiprocessing import Pool
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl")); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
import rt_model as rm
import binstd_core as bc
MUZ = bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN

def null_obs(shared, B, mu, nrecs):
    per_t = [(L, u) for (L, u, _, _) in nrecs]
    return rm.am_obs(shared, 1, B, mu, per_t, rm.L_NULL)

def eval_cell(rng, B, mu, zn_v, with_null):
    arm = rm.reuse_arm(rng, B, mu)
    obs = rm.am_obs(arm["rel_att"], 1, B, mu, arm["per_t"], rm.L_IC)
    v = rm.values_for_committed(arm, obs)
    ct = bc.gate_tests(v, zn_v); cc = bc.classify_cell(ct)
    mt = rm.text_tests(v, zn_v); mc = rm.text_class(mt)
    ya = bc.yield_audit(v); mz, mdef = rm.text_yield(v)
    rec = {"phi": cc, "phi_text": mc, "tests": ct, "tests_match": ct == mt and cc == mc,
           "delta": arm["delta_hat"], "u_minus_d2": arm["u_hat"] - arm["delta_hat"] ** 2,
           "a_bar": arm["a_bar"], "u_hat": arm["u_hat"], "n_dec": arm["n_dec"],
           "rho_rel": v["rho_rel"], "KR": v["KR"], "FR": v["FR"], "d_sigma": v["d_sigma"],
           "kappa_z": ya["z"], "deficit": ya["coverage_deficit"], "yield_match": abs(ya["z"] - mz) < 1e-9 and ya["coverage_deficit"] == mdef,
           "ctl6_delta_ok": arm["delta_hat"] < 0.95, "abandoned": arm["abandoned"]}
    p = 1 - math.exp(-mu * arm["u_hat"]); rec["Ta_z"] = (arm["a_bar"] - 1 / p) / (math.sqrt(1 - p) / p / math.sqrt(arm["n_t"]))
    if with_null:
        nrecs = rm.null_arm_fast(rng, B, mu)
        nob = null_obs(arm["rel_att"], B, mu, nrecs)
        bd = bc.am_bands(B, mu, arm["n_t"])
        f, disc = bc.null_check(nob, bd)
        mdisc = rm.text_null_discriminates(nob, rm.bands(B, mu, arm["n_t"]))
        rec.update({"null_disc": disc, "null_match": disc == mdisc, "null_KR": nob["KR"], "null_FR": nob["FR"],
                    "null_dsig": nob["d_sigma"], "null_unsolved": sum(1 for r in nrecs if not r[2]),
                    "null_rels_mean": sum(r[3] for r in nrecs) / len(nrecs)})
    return rec, v

def worker(args):
    regime, reps, seed = args
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    mu_b = {"nominal": 1.0, "mu0.5": 0.5, "mu2.0": 2.0}[regime]
    out = []
    for r in range(reps):
        zrec, zv = eval_cell(rng, 128, MUZ, None, True)
        orec, _ = eval_cell(rng, 512, mu_b, zv, True)
        krec, _ = eval_cell(rng, 512, mu_b, zv, False)
        out.append({"ZN": zrec, "ORD": orec, "KOB": krec})
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    regime, reps, base = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
    nproc = 4; per = reps // nproc
    seeds = [base + i for i in range(nproc)]
    t0 = time.time()
    with Pool(nproc) as pool:
        chunks = pool.map(worker, [(regime, per, s) for s in seeds])
    recs = [r for c in chunks for r in c]
    with open(os.path.join(SCR, "out", "c04_%s_records.jsonl" % regime), "w") as fh:
        for r in recs: fh.write(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    n = len(recs)
    summ = {"regime": regime, "reps": n, "seeds": seeds, "elapsed_s": round(time.time() - t0, 1),
            "python": sys.version.split()[0]}
    for cell in ("ZN", "ORD", "KOB"):
        cls, tf, mm = {}, {}, 0
        for r in recs:
            c = r[cell]; cls[c["phi"]] = cls.get(c["phi"], 0) + 1
            for k, s in c["tests"].items():
                if s != "pass": tf[k + ":" + s] = tf.get(k + ":" + s, 0) + 1
            mm += (not c["tests_match"]) + (not c["yield_match"]) + (0 if c.get("null_match", True) else 1)
        ds = [r[cell]["delta"] for r in recs]; md = sum(ds) / n
        sd = math.sqrt(sum((x - md) ** 2 for x in ds) / (n - 1))
        B = 128 if cell == "ZN" else 512
        taz = [r[cell]["Ta_z"] for r in recs]; mt = sum(taz) / n
        kz = [r[cell]["kappa_z"] for r in recs]; mk = sum(kz) / n
        s = {"class_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(cls.items())},
             "non_PASS_rate": 1 - cls.get("PASS", 0) / n,
             "test_fail_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tf.items())},
             "text_vs_committed_mismatches": mm,
             "delta_mean": md, "delta_sd": sd, "delta_sd_times_sqrtB": sd * math.sqrt(B),
             "delta_min": min(ds), "delta_max": max(ds),
             "P_delta_ge_0.95": sum(1 for x in ds if x >= 0.95) / n,
             "Ta_z_mean": mt, "Ta_z_sd": math.sqrt(sum((x - mt) ** 2 for x in taz) / (n - 1)),
             "kappa_z_mean": mk, "kappa_z_sd": math.sqrt(sum((x - mk) ** 2 for x in kz) / (n - 1)),
             "deficit_rate": sum(1 for r in recs if r[cell]["deficit"]) / n,
             "lnKR_sd": math.sqrt(sum(math.log(r[cell]["KR"]) ** 2 for r in recs) / n),
             "lnFR_sd": math.sqrt(sum(math.log(r[cell]["FR"]) ** 2 for r in recs) / n),
             "d_sigma_absmax": max(abs(r[cell]["d_sigma"]) for r in recs),
             "abandoned_total": sum(r[cell]["abandoned"] for r in recs)}
        if "null_disc" in recs[0][cell]:
            s["null_not_discriminating_rate"] = sum(1 for r in recs if not r[cell]["null_disc"]) / n
            s["null_KR_max"] = max(r[cell]["null_KR"] for r in recs)
            s["null_FR_min"] = min(r[cell]["null_FR"] for r in recs)
            s["null_dsig_min"] = min(r[cell]["null_dsig"] for r in recs)
            s["null_unsolved_targets_total"] = sum(r[cell]["null_unsolved"] for r in recs)
            s["null_mean_relations_per_target_over_B"] = sum(r[cell]["null_rels_mean"] for r in recs) / n / B
        summ[cell] = s
    # G1 conjuncts modelled here: (a) ZN PASS, (b) null discriminates, (c) delta < 0.95, (g) no abandoned
    g1 = [r["ZN"]["phi"] == "PASS" and r["ZN"]["null_disc"] and r["ZN"]["ctl6_delta_ok"] and r["ZN"]["abandoned"] == 0 for r in recs]
    summ["G1_H1_part_fail_rate"] = 1 - sum(g1) / n
    ax = {}
    for r, ok in zip(recs, g1):
        if not ok: continue
        phi = {bc.ORD_CELL: r["ORD"]["phi"], bc.KOB_CELL: r["KOB"]["phi"]}
        inv = (not r["ORD"]["null_disc"]) or (not r["ORD"]["ctl6_delta_ok"]) or (not r["KOB"]["ctl6_delta_ok"])
        halted = {bc.ORD_CELL: r["ORD"]["abandoned"] > 0, bc.KOB_CELL: r["KOB"]["abandoned"] > 0}
        dfc = {bc.ORD_CELL: r["ORD"]["deficit"], bc.KOB_CELL: r["KOB"]["deficit"]}
        a = bc.h1_axis(phi, halted, inv, dfc); ax[a] = ax.get(a, 0) + 1
    m = sum(ax.values())
    summ["H1_axis_given_G1_H1part"] = {k: v / m for k, v in sorted(ax.items())}
    print(json.dumps(summ, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

items.purpose: J3 (ii): per-cell false-fail of the H2 band, G1 (d), (e) and IR-3b
items.script_text:
"""C05: red-team Monte Carlo of H2 (i) under the contract's abstract model: a
lazily realised RANDOM MAPPING on N_G points with the I2 semantics read from the
specification and rho_multi's docstring: walks start at a uniform point; a point
is distinguished iff ((x // 20) & (2^dp - 1)) == 0; at a NEW distinguished point
the walk stores it and continues; a hit on a stored point solves if it belongs to
another walk of the same target or to an earlier (solved) target, and abandons the
walk if it is the same walk; after 20 * 2^dp steps the walk is abandoned; the
table is carried across targets solved in order; walk_ops counts steps. One fresh
random mapping per rho_multi call (one call per (L, seed) and per reference
solve). No group, oracle, curve or declared cell; N_G and dp_bits are the
contract's stated design values (1048583 / 3; 261823 / 1; 130873 / 1).
Pools of independent calls are generated, then replicates of the contract's
statistic (W1 from 150 single solves, c(L) from 30 calls per L) are assembled by
sampling distinct pool members (bootstrap of the sampling distribution).
usage: c05_h2_mc.py CELL POOLSEED"""
import json, math, os, random, sys, time
from multiprocessing import Pool
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
CELLS = {"CTRL-ZN": (1048583, 3), "BIN-ORD-19": (261823, 1), "BIN-KOB-19": (130873, 1)}
L_RHO = (1, 4, 16, 64, 256)
POOL = {1: 8000, 4: 2000, 16: 1000, 64: 600, 256: 400}

def rho_call(rng, N, dp, n_targets):
    mask = (1 << dp) - 1; max_len = 20 << dp
    f = {}; table = {}; ops = 0; wid = 0; solved = set(); walks = aband = 0
    for t in range(n_targets):
        done = False
        while not done:
            wid += 1; walks += 1
            X = rng.randrange(N)
            for _ in range(max_len):
                if ((X // 20) & mask) == 0:
                    prev = table.get(X)
                    if prev is not None:
                        t2, w2 = prev
                        if t2 == t and w2 != wid: done = True
                        elif t2 != t and t2 in solved: done = True
                        else: aband += 1
                        break
                    table[X] = (t, wid)
                nx = f.get(X)
                if nx is None:
                    nx = rng.randrange(N); f[X] = nx
                X = nx; ops += 1
            else:
                aband += 1
        solved.add(t)
    return ops, len(table)

def pool_worker(args):
    cell, L, count, seed = args
    N, dp = CELLS[cell]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    return [rho_call(rng, N, dp, L)[0] for _ in range(count)]

def slope(xs, ys):
    n = len(xs); mx = sum(xs) / n; my = sum(ys) / n
    return sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) / sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cell, base = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
    N, dp = CELLS[cell]
    t0 = time.time()
    jobs = []; k = 0
    for L in L_RHO:
        per = POOL[L] // 4
        for j in range(4):
            jobs.append((cell, L, per, base + 100 * L + j)); k += 1
    with Pool(4) as pool:
        res = pool.map(pool_worker, jobs)
    pools = {L: [] for L in L_RHO}
    for (c, L, per, s), r in zip(jobs, res): pools[L].extend(r)
    json.dump({str(L): v for L, v in pools.items()}, open(os.path.join(SCR, "out", "c05_pool_%s.json" % cell), "w"))
    t_pool = time.time() - t0
    sq = math.sqrt(math.pi * N / 2.0)
    stats = {}
    for L in L_RHO:
        v = pools[L]; m = sum(v) / len(v); sd = math.sqrt(sum((x - m) ** 2 for x in v) / (len(v) - 1))
        stats[str(L)] = {"n": len(v), "mean": m, "cv": sd / m, "mean_over_sqrt_pi_N_over_2": m / sq}
    W = stats["1"]["mean"]
    for L in L_RHO:
        stats[str(L)]["pool_c_L"] = stats[str(L)]["mean"] / (math.sqrt(L) * W)
    # replicate assembly
    rng = random.Random(base + 7)
    R = 40000
    xs = [math.log2(L) for L in L_RHO]
    fail = {"c1_low": 0, "c1_high": 0, "cL_high_L>=4": 0, "cL_low_L>=4": 0, "exp_out": 0,
            "h2_fail": 0, "instr_fail": 0, "exp_out_or_instr_fail_G1de": 0}
    by_L_high = {str(L): 0 for L in L_RHO}; by_L_low = {str(L): 0 for L in L_RHO}
    cs = {str(L): [] for L in L_RHO}; exps = []
    for r in range(R):
        idx = rng.sample(range(len(pools[1])), 180)
        W1 = sum(pools[1][i] for i in idx[:150]) / 150.0
        means = {1: sum(pools[1][i] for i in idx[150:]) / 30.0}
        for L in L_RHO[1:]:
            means[L] = sum(pools[L][i] for i in rng.sample(range(len(pools[L])), 30)) / 30.0
        c = {L: means[L] / (math.sqrt(L) * W1) for L in L_RHO}
        e = slope(xs, [math.log2(means[L] / L) for L in L_RHO])
        exps.append(e)
        for L in L_RHO: cs[str(L)].append(c[L])
        h2 = (-0.6 <= e <= -0.4) and all(0.8 <= c[L] <= 1.3 for L in L_RHO)
        ins = all(0.5 <= c[L] <= 2.0 for L in L_RHO)
        if not h2: fail["h2_fail"] += 1
        if not ins: fail["instr_fail"] += 1
        if not ((-0.6 <= e <= -0.4) and ins): fail["exp_out_or_instr_fail_G1de"] += 1
        if c[1] < 0.8: fail["c1_low"] += 1
        if c[1] > 1.3: fail["c1_high"] += 1
        if any(c[L] > 1.3 for L in L_RHO[1:]): fail["cL_high_L>=4"] += 1
        if any(c[L] < 0.8 for L in L_RHO[1:]): fail["cL_low_L>=4"] += 1
        if not (-0.6 <= e <= -0.4): fail["exp_out"] += 1
        for L in L_RHO:
            if c[L] > 1.3: by_L_high[str(L)] += 1
            if c[L] < 0.8: by_L_low[str(L)] += 1
    def q(v, p): v = sorted(v); return v[int(p * (len(v) - 1))]
    out = {"cell": cell, "N_G": N, "dp_bits": dp, "pool_seeds": sorted(set(j[3] for j in jobs)),
           "assembly_seed": base + 7, "replicates": R, "pool_sizes": POOL,
           "pool_seconds": round(t_pool, 1), "sqrt_pi_N_over_2": sq, "pool_stats": stats,
           "rates": {k: v / R for k, v in fail.items()},
           "c_L_above_1.3_rate": {k: v / R for k, v in by_L_high.items()},
           "c_L_below_0.8_rate": {k: v / R for k, v in by_L_low.items()},
           "c_L_quantiles_1_50_99": {L: [q(v, 0.01), q(v, 0.5), q(v, 0.99)] for L, v in cs.items()},
           "exponent_quantiles_0.1_50_99.9": [q(exps, 0.001), q(exps, 0.5), q(exps, 0.999)],
           "python": sys.version.split()[0]}
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

"""C05b: DIRECT full-replicate check of C05 (no pooling/bootstrap): each replicate
runs 150 fresh single-target calls (W1) and 30 fresh calls at each L in 1, 4, 16,
64, 256, exactly the contract's design, under the same random-mapping I2 model
(rho_call imported from c05_h2_mc.py). usage: c05b_h2_direct.py CELL REPS SEED"""
import json, math, os, random, sys, time
from multiprocessing import Pool
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
from c05_h2_mc import rho_call, CELLS, L_RHO, slope

def rep_worker(args):
    cell, n, seed = args
    N, dp = CELLS[cell]; rng = random.Random(seed); out = []
    xs = [math.log2(L) for L in L_RHO]
    for _ in range(n):
        W1 = sum(rho_call(rng, N, dp, 1)[0] for _ in range(150)) / 150.0
        m = {L: sum(rho_call(rng, N, dp, L)[0] for _ in range(30)) / 30.0 for L in L_RHO}
        c = {L: m[L] / (math.sqrt(L) * W1) for L in L_RHO}
        e = slope(xs, [math.log2(m[L] / L) for L in L_RHO])
        out.append((W1, [c[L] for L in L_RHO], e))
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cell, reps, base = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
    t0 = time.time(); seeds = [base + i for i in range(4)]
    with Pool(4) as pool:
        res = pool.map(rep_worker, [(cell, reps // 4, s) for s in seeds])
    rows = [r for c in res for r in c]; n = len(rows)
    h2f = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if not ((-0.6 <= e <= -0.4) and all(0.8 <= x <= 1.3 for x in c)))
    c1l = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if c[0] < 0.8); c1h = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if c[0] > 1.3)
    cLh = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if any(x > 1.3 for x in c[1:]))
    ins = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if not all(0.5 <= x <= 2.0 for x in c))
    eo = sum(1 for (_, c, e) in rows if not (-0.6 <= e <= -0.4))
    se = math.sqrt(max(h2f, 1) * (n - h2f) / n) / n
    print(json.dumps({"cell": cell, "replicates": n, "seeds": seeds, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1),
                      "h2_band_false_fail": h2f / n, "binomial_se": se, "c1_below_0.8": c1l / n,
                      "c1_above_1.3": c1h / n, "cL_above_1.3_L>=4": cLh / n,
                      "instrument_band_fail": ins / n, "exponent_out_of_band": eo / n,
                      "mean_c_L": [sum(r[1][i] for r in rows) / n for i in range(5)],
                      "mean_exponent": sum(r[2] for r in rows) / n}, sort_keys=True))

items.script_text:
"""C06: J3 item (i) rule sweep on a Monte Carlo sample of the contract's abstract
model under H1 AND H2: the 8000 C04 nominal H1 replicates (ZN with null, ORD with
null, KOB) are paired with 8000 independent H2 replicates per cell assembled from
the C05 random-mapping pools (assembly seed 810095606). Every replicate is fed to
the committed binstd_core.stage2_outcome (dry call on synthetic dicts; correct
instruments: S0 passed, certificates true, I1 self-test true, admissions true,
complete audits with 0 discrepancies, no IR-1/2/6/7) and to the red team's own
text-level evaluation of the outcome_table; firing frequencies are tallied rule by
rule. No group, oracle, curve or declared cell."""
import json, math, os, random, sys
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl")); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
import binstd_core as bc
L_RHO = (1, 4, 16, 64, 256)
def slope(xs, ys):
    n = len(xs); mx = sum(xs) / n; my = sum(ys) / n
    return sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) / sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)
pools = {c: {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(os.path.join(SCR, "out", "c05_pool_%s.json" % c))).items()}
         for c in ("CTRL-ZN", "BIN-ORD-19", "BIN-KOB-19")}
rng = random.Random(810095606)
def h2_draw(cell):
    p = pools[cell]; idx = rng.sample(range(len(p[1])), 180)
    W1 = sum(p[1][i] for i in idx[:150]) / 150.0
    m = {1: sum(p[1][i] for i in idx[150:]) / 30.0}
    for L in L_RHO[1:]:
        m[L] = sum(p[L][i] for i in rng.sample(range(len(p[L])), 30)) / 30.0
    c = [m[L] / (math.sqrt(L) * W1) for L in L_RHO]
    e = slope([math.log2(L) for L in L_RHO], [math.log2(m[L] / L) for L in L_RHO])
    return {"exponent_rho": e, "pools": c,
            "h2_pass": (-0.6 <= e <= -0.4) and all(0.8 <= x <= 1.3 for x in c),
            "instrument_ok": all(0.5 <= x <= 2.0 for x in c)}
recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(os.path.join(SCR, "out", "c04_nominal_records.jsonl"))]
tally = {"contract": {}, "contract_text": {}, "H1": {}, "H2": {}, "mismatch_committed_vs_text": 0,
         "rules": {k: 0 for k in ("G1a_reuse_not_PASS", "G1b_null_inside_band", "G1c_ctl6", "G1d_exponent",
                                  "G1e_pool_instrument", "G1g_abandoned", "G1_any", "S5_binary_abandoned",
                                  "IR3b_binary", "IR9_ORD_null", "IR10_binary", "H2band_ZN", "H2band_ORD",
                                  "H2band_KOB", "yield_deficit_ORD", "yield_deficit_KOB")}}
def bump(d, k): d[k] = d.get(k, 0) + 1
for r in recs:
    zr, orr, kr = r["ZN"], r["ORD"], r["KOB"]
    hz, ho, hk = h2_draw("CTRL-ZN"), h2_draw("BIN-ORD-19"), h2_draw("BIN-KOB-19")
    g1 = {"a": zr["phi"] == "PASS", "b": zr["null_disc"], "c": zr["ctl6_delta_ok"],
          "d": -0.6 <= hz["exponent_rho"] <= -0.4, "e": hz["instrument_ok"], "f": True,
          "g": zr["abandoned"] == 0, "h": True, "i": True}
    for k, ok in g1.items():
        if not ok and ("G1%s" % k) in [x[:3] for x in tally["rules"]]:
            pass
    R = tally["rules"]
    R["G1a_reuse_not_PASS"] += not g1["a"]; R["G1b_null_inside_band"] += not g1["b"]
    R["G1c_ctl6"] += not g1["c"]; R["G1d_exponent"] += not g1["d"]; R["G1e_pool_instrument"] += not g1["e"]
    R["G1g_abandoned"] += not g1["g"]; G1 = all(g1.values()); R["G1_any"] += not G1
    R["H2band_ZN"] += not hz["h2_pass"]; R["H2band_ORD"] += not ho["h2_pass"]; R["H2band_KOB"] += not hk["h2_pass"]
    R["S5_binary_abandoned"] += (orr["abandoned"] > 0) or (kr["abandoned"] > 0)
    R["IR3b_binary"] += (not ho["instrument_ok"]) or (not hk["instrument_ok"])
    R["IR9_ORD_null"] += not orr["null_disc"]
    R["IR10_binary"] += (not orr["ctl6_delta_ok"]) or (not kr["ctl6_delta_ok"])
    R["yield_deficit_ORD"] += orr["deficit"]; R["yield_deficit_KOB"] += kr["deficit"]
    def cdict(c, h, null):
        d = {"reuse": {"phi": c["phi"], "abandoned": c["abandoned"],
                       "yield_audit": {"coverage_deficit": c["deficit"]}},
             "ctl6": {"ok": c["ctl6_delta_ok"]}, "ir5": {"ic_reading_valid": True}, "rho": h}
        if null is not None: d["null"] = {"discriminates": null}
        return d
    cells = {bc.ORD_CELL: cdict(orr, ho, orr["null_disc"]), bc.KOB_CELL: cdict(kr, hk, None)}
    flags = {"S0_pass": True, "G1_pass": G1, "IR1_fired": False, "IR2_fired": False, "IR6_fired": False, "IR7_fired": False}
    adm = {c: {x: True for x in bc.ADMISSION_RULES} for c in bc.BINARY_CELLS}
    aud = {c: {"relation_attempts_checked": 256, "targets_checked": 128, "discrepancies": 0} for c in bc.BINARY_CELLS}
    out = bc.stage2_outcome({"rho": hz}, cells, flags, adm, aud)
    bump(tally["contract"], out["contract"]); bump(tally["H1"], out["H1"]); bump(tally["H2"], out["H2"])
    # text-level evaluation (outcome_table, success_criterion), independent of stage2_outcome
    if not G1: lab = "RUN-ARTIFACT"
    else:
        halted = {n: c["abandoned"] > 0 for n, c in (("O", orr), ("K", kr))}
        icinv = (not orr["null_disc"]) or (not orr["ctl6_delta_ok"]) or (not kr["ctl6_delta_ok"])
        rhoinv = (not ho["instrument_ok"]) or (not hk["instrument_ok"])
        if icinv: h1 = "ART"
        elif any(halted.values()): h1 = "INC"
        else:
            a, b = orr["phi"], kr["phi"]
            if a == b == "PASS": h1 = "POS"
            elif "PASS" in (a, b): h1 = "MIX"
            elif a == b == "LOW-COV": h1 = "NEGC"
            elif a == b == "LOW-RETRY" and orr["deficit"] and kr["deficit"]: h1 = "NEGY"
            else: h1 = "NEGD"
        if rhoinv: h2 = "ART"
        elif any(halted.values()): h2 = "INC"
        elif hz["h2_pass"] and ho["h2_pass"] and hk["h2_pass"]: h2 = "POS"
        elif not ho["h2_pass"] and not hk["h2_pass"]: h2 = "NEG"
        else: h2 = "MIX"
        if h1 == "POS" and h2 == "POS": lab = "POSITIVE"
        elif h1.startswith("NEG") or h2 == "NEG": lab = "NEGATIVE"
        else: lab = "NOT-VALIDATED"
    bump(tally["contract_text"], lab)
    tally["mismatch_committed_vs_text"] += lab != out["contract"]
n = len(recs)
res = {"replicates": n, "assembly_seed": 810095606, "h1_records": "out/c04_nominal_records.jsonl (C04 seeds 810095100-103)",
       "contract_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tally["contract"].items())},
       "contract_rate_text": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tally["contract_text"].items())},
       "H1_axis_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tally["H1"].items())},
       "H2_axis_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tally["H2"].items())},
       "rule_fire_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in tally["rules"].items()},
       "mismatch_committed_vs_text": tally["mismatch_committed_vs_text"]}
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

items.title: AM reductions, AM3 dominance, admissible ranges
items.purpose: J3 (v) and confinement check per regime
items.script_text:
"""C07: J3 item (v), AM reductions, on synthetic per-target tables (dry calls of
committed am_core / sigma_pred / k_pred / a_pred / am_bands). Seed 810095007.
(1) FR == a_bar / a_pred and KR * FR == rho_rel exactly when per-target units are
attempts x w; (2) AM3 dominance: the KR interval on which d_sigma(KR) =
sigma_pred(KR K_pred) - sigma_pred(K_pred) lies in [-0.1, 0.1], per regime, against
the per-cell KR band; (3) admissible range of each gated observable against its
band per regime (confinement check); (4) what AM1..AM3 read if per-target units
DO depend on L (a synthetic L-dependent arm), i.e. whether the L-dimension can
show anywhere in the reuse arm's gates."""
import json, math, os, random, sys
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl"))
import binstd_core as bc
rng = random.Random(810095007)
res = {"seed": 810095007}
# (1) identities
worst = 0.0
for trial in range(200):
    B = rng.choice((128, 500, 512, 530)); mu = rng.uniform(0.02, 2.0); w = rng.choice((1, 256, 1024))
    rel_att = rng.randint(B, 40 * B)
    recs = [{"L": L, "units": rng.randint(1, 400) * w} for L, ts in bc.cells_of(bc.L_IC).items() for t in ts]
    o = bc.am_core(rel_att * w, w, B, mu, recs, bc.L_IC)
    a_bar = sum(r["units"] for r in recs) / len(recs) / w
    rho_rel = rel_att * (-math.expm1(-mu)) / B
    worst = max(worst, abs(o["FR"] - a_bar / bc.a_pred(mu)) / o["FR"], abs(o["KR"] * o["FR"] - rho_rel) / rho_rel)
res["identities_max_rel_error_200_trials"] = worst
# (2) AM3 dominance per regime
def dsig(KR, K): return bc.sigma_pred(KR * K, bc.L_IC) - bc.sigma_pred(K, bc.L_IC)
def root(f, lo, hi):
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = math.sqrt(lo * hi)
        if (f(lo) > 0) == (f(mid) > 0): lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    return math.sqrt(lo * hi)
regimes = {"CTRL-ZN": (128, bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN), "bin_mu0.5": (512, 0.5), "bin_mu1": (512, 1.0), "bin_mu2": (512, 2.0)}
dom = {}
for name, (B, mu) in regimes.items():
    K = bc.k_pred(B, mu); bd = bc.am_bands(B, mu, 1365)
    lo = root(lambda x: dsig(x, K) - 0.1, 1e-4, 1.0)       # d_sigma = +0.1 (KR small -> slope shallower)
    hi = root(lambda x: dsig(x, K) + 0.1, 1.0, 1e4)        # d_sigma = -0.1
    dom[name] = {"K_pred": K, "AM3_pass_KR_interval": [lo, hi], "KR_band": list(bd["KR"]),
                 "AM3_dominated_by_AM1": lo < bd["KR"][0] and hi > bd["KR"][1],
                 "dsigma_at_band_edges": [dsig(bd["KR"][0], K), dsig(bd["KR"][1], K)]}
res["AM3_dominance"] = dom
# (3) admissible ranges vs bands (reuse arm)
adm = {}
for name, (B, mu) in regimes.items():
    ap, A = bc.a_pred(mu), 1 / (-math.expm1(-mu)); bd = bc.am_bands(B, mu, 1365)
    sp = bc.sigma_pred(bc.k_pred(B, mu), bc.L_IC)
    adm[name] = {"FR_admissible": [1 / ap, bc.MAX_ATTEMPTS / ap], "FR_band": list(bd["FR"]),
                 "KR_admissible_lower": ap / (A * bc.MAX_ATTEMPTS), "KR_band": list(bd["KR"]),
                 "d_sigma_admissible_reuse": [-1 - sp, -sp], "d_sigma_band": [-0.1, 0.1],
                 "confined": not ((1 / ap) < bd["FR"][0] and (-1 - sp) < -0.1 and -sp > 0.1)}
res["admissible_vs_band"] = adm
# (4) an L-dependent per-target cost fed to the reuse arm's gates (synthetic): per-target units
#     falling as L^-0.5 (a would-be extra L-amortisation) vs flat; does any gate see it?
B, mu = 512, 1.0; ap = bc.a_pred(mu); K = bc.k_pred(B, mu)
shared = B / (-math.expm1(-mu))
flat = [{"L": L, "units": ap} for L, ts in bc.cells_of(bc.L_IC).items() for t in ts]
dep = [{"L": L, "units": ap * (L ** -0.5) * 3.0} for L, ts in bc.cells_of(bc.L_IC).items() for t in ts]
of, od = bc.am_core(shared, 1, B, mu, flat, bc.L_IC), bc.am_core(shared, 1, B, mu, dep, bc.L_IC)

items.title: LOW-RETRY mapping under matched-mean coverage deficits/excess; coset-factor sensitivity
coset-subgraph structure of the binary relation graphs
items.purpose: nearby-structure check of H1's uniform-leg law (2 subgraphs on ORD, 3 on KOB)
items.script_text:
"""C09b: nearby-structure check of H1's uniform-leg law on the binary cells. For
R in G, P1 + P2 = R forces the two legs into cosets i and -i of G, so (with F
balanced over the cosets) the column set splits into classes that never share a
relation: BIN-ORD-19 (h = 2): two subgraphs of B/2 columns, weight 1/2 each;
BIN-KOB-19 (h = 4, E/G cyclic of order 4 on F_2): cosets {0}, {2}, {1,3} give
subgraphs of B/4, B/4, B/2 columns with weights 1/4, 1/4, 1/2. Relations and
target decompositions pick a subgraph by weight, then uniform legs within it.
Everything else is the abstract model of rt_model; predictions unchanged.
Classified by the committed classifiers (dry calls). Abstract, synthetic.
usage: SEED REPS"""
import json, math, os, random, sys
from multiprocessing import Pool
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl")); sys.path.insert(0, SCR)
import rt_model as rm, binstd_core as bc
MUZ = bc.MU_ZN_DESIGN
PARTS = {"ORD": [(0, 256, 0.5), (256, 512, 0.5)],
         "KOB": [(0, 128, 0.25), (128, 256, 0.25), (256, 512, 0.5)]}

def legs(rng, parts):
    x = rng.random(); acc = 0.0
    for lo, hi, w in parts:
        acc += w
        if x < acc: break
    while True:
        i, k = rng.randrange(lo, hi), rng.randrange(lo, hi)
        s, t = (1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1), (1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1)
        if i == k and s == -t: continue
        return i, s, k, t

def arm(rng, B, mu, parts):
    q = 1 - math.exp(-mu); rel_att = 0; edges = []
    for _ in range(B):
        rel_att += rm.geom(rng, q); edges.append(legs(rng, parts))
    det, _ = rm.determined_set(B, edges)
    per_t = []; nd = nu = na = nn = 0
    for L in rm.L_IC:
        for _ in range(L):
            a = ne = 0
            while True:
                a += rm.geom(rng, q); ne += 1
                D = rm.ztp(rng, mu); nd += D; uu = 0
                for _d in range(D):
                    i, s, k, t = legs(rng, parts)
                    if det[i] and det[k]: uu += 1
                nu += uu
                if uu: break
            per_t.append((L, a)); na += a; nn += ne
    return {"B": B, "mu": mu, "rel_att": rel_att, "delta_hat": sum(det) / B, "u_hat": nu / nd,
            "n_dec": nd, "n_att": na, "n_t": rm.N_T, "a_bar": na / rm.N_T, "kappa_hat": nn / na,
            "per_t": per_t, "abandoned": 0}

def work(args):
    name, reps, seed = args
    rng = random.Random(seed); cls = {}; tf = {}; ud = []; ds = []
    for _ in range(reps):
        za = rm.reuse_arm(rng, 128, MUZ)
        zv = rm.values_for_committed(za, rm.am_obs(za["rel_att"], 1, 128, MUZ, za["per_t"], rm.L_IC))
        a = arm(rng, 512, 1.0, PARTS[name])
        v = rm.values_for_committed(a, rm.am_obs(a["rel_att"], 1, 512, 1.0, a["per_t"], rm.L_IC))
        t = bc.gate_tests(v, zv); c = bc.classify_cell(t); cls[c] = cls.get(c, 0) + 1
        for kk, s in t.items():
            if s != "pass": tf[kk + ":" + s] = tf.get(kk + ":" + s, 0) + 1
        ud.append(v["u_hat"] - v["delta_hat"] ** 2); ds.append(v["delta_hat"])
    return cls, tf, ud, ds

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed, reps = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
    jobs = [(n, reps // 2, seed + 10 * i + j) for i, n in enumerate(("ORD", "KOB")) for j in range(2)]
    with Pool(4) as pool:
        out = pool.map(work, jobs)
    res = {"seed_base": seed, "reps_per_cell": reps}
    for name in ("ORD", "KOB"):
        cls, tf, ud, ds = {}, {}, [], []
        for (n, r, s), (c, t, u, d) in zip(jobs, out):
            if n != name: continue
            for k, v in c.items(): cls[k] = cls.get(k, 0) + v
            for k, v in t.items(): tf[k] = tf.get(k, 0) + v
            ud += u; ds += d
        n = len(ds); md = sum(ds) / n
        res[name] = {"seeds": [s for (nn, r, s) in jobs if nn == name],
                     "class_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(cls.items())},
                     "non_PASS_rate": 1 - cls.get("PASS", 0) / n,
                     "test_fail_rate": {k: v / n for k, v in sorted(tf.items())},
                     "mean_u_minus_delta2": sum(ud) / n,
                     "delta_mean": md, "delta_sd_times_sqrtB": math.sqrt(sum((x - md) ** 2 for x in ds) / (n - 1)) * math.sqrt(512)}
    print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

items.script_text:
"""C11: J4 item (ii). The range of the multi-target constant c on which the TW-01
containment clause holds, under the contract's model M_m (definitions.model_Mm,
cap_locus_and_constants, frontier), own implementation from the TEXT, mpmath at
50 digits; cross-checked against committed stage0.py pure functions (dry calls).
Readings: (R1) LITERAL, as the clause and D-12 define it: every non-empty window's
antecedent C lies below the T_gen COLUMN value (T_gen(m) at S = B_cap(m); for the
whole committed m = 4 range, T_gen(4)). (R2) MATCHED ADVICE: the antecedent C lies
below the generic S T^2 = N_prime line at the window's OWN advice S = B words,
T_gen(B) = sqrt(N_prime / B) (what 'the windows are the first-below-the-line clause
restated' requires). (R3) R2 with the index-calculus ONLINE per-target cost
A(mu) retry_m C in place of C."""
import json, math, os, sys
import mpmath as mp
mp.mp.dps = 50
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SCR, "impl"))
import stage0 as s0
r = mp.mpf(680564733841876926932320129493409985129)
L2 = lambda x: mp.log(x, 2)
l2Np = L2(r / 262); l2rho = L2(mp.sqrt(mp.pi * r / (4 * 131)))
def l2bcap(m): return (131 + L2(mp.factorial(m))) / m
def mu(m, xB): return mp.power(2, m * xB - L2(mp.factorial(m)) - 131)
def A(x): return 1 / (1 - mp.exp(-x))
def retry(m): return 1 / (1 - m * mp.exp(-m))
def l2Ccrit(m, xB, c, k=1):
    """log2 of the largest C with a non-empty window: 4ab = 1 with
    a = A retry C / (c rho), b = (B A C + k m B^2) / (c rho)."""
    B = mp.power(2, xB); a_ = A(mu(m, xB)); rh = mp.power(2, l2rho)
    alpha = 4 * a_ * retry(m) * B * a_ / (c * c * rh * rh)
    beta = 4 * a_ * retry(m) * k * m * B * B / (c * c * rh * rh)
    C = (-beta + mp.sqrt(beta * beta + 4 * alpha)) / (2 * alpha)
    return L2(C)
def l2Tgen_own(xB): return (l2Np - xB) / 2
def online(m, xB): return L2(A(mu(m, xB)) * retry(m))
GRID = [mp.mpf("29.036035") + mp.mpf("0.01") * i for i in range(697)]
res = {"mp_dps": 50, "log2_N_prime": float(l2Np), "log2_rho_1": float(l2rho)}
# --- at B = B_cap(m) ---
cap = {}
for m in (4, 5, 6, 8, 16):
    xb = l2bcap(m); tg = l2Tgen_own(xb)
    m1 = tg - l2Ccrit(m, xb, 1)                         # R1 = R2 at the cap (own advice = B_cap)
    m3 = tg - (l2Ccrit(m, xb, 1) + online(m, xb))       # R3
    cap[str(m)] = {"log2_B_cap": float(xb), "log2_T_gen": float(tg), "log2_Ccrit_c1": float(l2Ccrit(m, xb, 1)),
                   "margin_R1_R2_c1": float(m1), "c_max_R1_R2": float(mp.power(2, m1)),
                   "log2_online_constant": float(online(m, xb)),
                   "margin_R3_c1": float(m3), "c_max_R3": float(mp.power(2, m3))}
res["at_B_cap"] = cap
# --- committed m = 4 range ---
def env_close(c):
    best = max(GRID, key=lambda xb: l2Ccrit(4, xb, c)); return best, l2Ccrit(4, best, c)
def own_margin(c, with_online=False):
    vals = []
    for xb in GRID:
        cc = l2Ccrit(4, xb, c) + (online(4, xb) if with_online else 0)
        vals.append((l2Tgen_own(xb) - cc, xb))
    return min(vals)
tg4 = l2Tgen_own(l2bcap(4))
b1, cl1 = env_close(1)
mo1, xo1 = own_margin(1); mo3, xo3 = own_margin(1, True)
def bisect_c(fun, lo=1.0, hi=4.0):
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if fun(mid) > 0: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    return (lo + hi) / 2
cmax_R1 = bisect_c(lambda c: float(tg4 - env_close(c)[1]))
cmax_R2 = bisect_c(lambda c: float(own_margin(c)[0]))
cmax_R3 = bisect_c(lambda c: float(own_margin(c, True)[0]), lo=0.5)
res["m4_committed_range"] = {
    "grid_points": len(GRID), "closing_log2_C_c1": float(cl1), "closing_at_log2_B": float(b1),
    "margin_R1_vs_T_gen4_c1": float(tg4 - cl1), "c_max_R1": cmax_R1,
    "min_margin_R2_own_advice_c1": float(mo1), "at_log2_B": float(xo1), "c_max_R2": cmax_R2,
    "min_margin_R3_online_own_advice_c1": float(mo3), "at_log2_B_R3": float(xo3), "c_max_R3": cmax_R3,
    "asymptotic_R2_margin_mu_large": float((L2(mp.pi) - 1) / 2 - 1 - L2(retry(4)) / 2),
    "own_advice_T_gen_at_closing_base": float(l2Tgen_own(b1)),
    "margin_R2_at_closing_base_c1": float(l2Tgen_own(b1) - cl1)}
# --- stated figures: shift of the closing C by log2 c, and the BL constants ---
chk = {}
for c in (1.128, 1.66, 1.8, 2.0, 2.01, 2.15, 2.36):
    bc_, cl = env_close(c)
    om = own_margin(c)
    chk[str(c)] = {"closing_log2_C": float(cl), "shift_minus_log2c": float(cl - cl1 - L2(c)),
                   "closing_minus_T_gen4": float(cl - tg4), "closing_at_log2_B": float(bc_),
                   "min_own_advice_margin": float(om[0]), "at_log2_B": float(om[1]),
                   "m4_cap_margin": float(tg4 - l2Ccrit(4, l2bcap(4), c)),
                   "m5_cap_margin": float(l2Tgen_own(l2bcap(5)) - l2Ccrit(5, l2bcap(5), c))}
res["by_c"] = chk
# --- count of committed-range bases whose own-advice line lies below T_gen(4) and
#     where a window can open for C in [T_gen(B), T_gen(4)) at c in (c_max_R2, c_max_R1)
res["bases_above_cap_in_range"] = sum(1 for xb in GRID if xb > l2bcap(4))
# --- cross-check with committed stage0 pure functions (dry calls, c = 1) ---
x5 = s0.bcap(5)
res["stage0_crosscheck"] = {
    "stage0_m5_crit_log2C": s0.D3_5 + s0.critical(lambda g: s0.win(5, x5, s0.D3_5 + g), 0.0, 20.0),
    "mine_m5_crit_log2C": float(l2Ccrit(5, l2bcap(5), 1)),
    "stage0_m4_cap_crit_log2C": s0.critical(lambda x: s0.win(4, s0.bcap(4), x), 0.0, 60.0),
    "mine_m4_cap_crit_log2C": float(l2Ccrit(4, l2bcap(4), 1)),
    "stage0_env_close_at_34.326035": s0.critical(lambda x: s0.win(4, 34.326035, x), 0.0, 80.0),
    "mine_env_close_at_34.326035": float(l2Ccrit(4, mp.mpf("34.326035"), 1))}
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

deficits at matched mean (kr < 1), per binary cell at nominal (512, mu = 1):

and T_rho (|ln rho_rel| > 3.3 sqrt(exp(-mu)/B)) to the gated tests (low side =
